name: certifiks
description: Engineering foundation for the CertiFiks verified-repair escrow protocol

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.protocol:generate: node protocol/generate-openapi.mjs && openapi-typescript protocol/openapi.v1.json -o packages/shared/src/generated/openapi.d.ts && biome format --write protocol/openapi.v1.json packages/shared/src/generated/openapi.d.ts
scripts.protocol:check: node protocol/generate-openapi.mjs --check && openapi-typescript protocol/openapi.v1.json -o packages/shared/src/generated/openapi.d.ts && biome format --write packages/shared/src/generated/openapi.d.ts && git diff --exit-code -- packages/shared/src/generated/openapi.d.ts
